thread:
maria-platops: Customer ping — production service in eu-west has spiked latency and invoices jumped. They claim they pinned to us-west but telemetry shows EU hits. Can someone triage?
aj-support: Thanks — opened an incident, collecting traces. Do we have recent config edits for that customer?
samir-engr: I pulled the policy from their account: `failover_policy` looks odd. Priority array is correct but weights look reversed (EU weight 0.9, US 0.1) and sticky routing TTL is 0. Short TTLs + high EU weight can flip routing under steady traffic.
samir-engr: snippet:```json
{"priority": ["us-west","eu-west"], "weights": {"us-west": 0.1, "eu-west": 0.9}, "sticky": true, "sticky_ttl_s": 30}
```
leo-cs: They definitely did not ask to route to EU. They mentioned a UI change last week to the routing form.
maria-platops: Did the UI change introduce decimal vs percentage parsing? We had a bug where "90%" became 0.9 and "10" became 10 in the backend, flipping semantics.
aj-support: I'm seeing related auth noise — customers reported intermittent 401s when requests hit EU because their API key is scoped to us-west. That caused retries and billing spikes.
samir-engr: Found logs showing oscillation every ~25s: routing TTL expire -> new selection picks EU due to high weight -> auth fail -> client retries -> TTL reset -> picks US -> repeat. Example log:```text
[12:03:10] select_region user=acct-123 choice=eu-west weight=0.9
[12:03:11] proxy auth failed key=acct-123 region=eu-west status=401
[12:03:12] client retry
[12:03:13] select_region user=acct-123 choice=us-west weight=0.1
```
infra-bot: deploy 2249.3 to routing-service applied at 12:05 UTC — included weight-parse fix but only in canary.
maria-platops: Can we rollback the UI change and force a policy patch for this tenant? Also need billing team to consider a refund window for the rogue retries.
aj-support: Repro steps for eng: 1) create policy with mixed formats (`"weights": {"us-west": "10", "eu-west": "90%"}`) 2) enable sticky with TTL 30s 3) issue concurrent requests with an API key scoped to one region 4) observe oscillation / 401 spikes in <2 minutes.
samir-engr: Quick mitigation: update their policy to explicit normalized weights (us-west: 0.9, eu-west: 0.1) and increase sticky_ttl_s to 300. Pushed patch to their account and watching metrics.
leo-cs: Customer confirmed latency dropped and billing abnormality looks like ~1.8x token usage during the window. They've asked for a credit.
maria-platops: Filing a postmortem action: 1) UI validator for weight formats (reject mixed types), 2) backend normalize rule + warning on ambiguous inputs, 3) add a safety: if auth 401s spike after a region switch, keep sticky lock for 5m to avoid oscillation.
aj-support: Noted. I'll flag billing and CS to start refund workflow.
samir-engr: Canary fix promoted to stable at 12:32 UTC. Metrics show region hits stabilized to 95% us-west in next 5m.
leo-cs: Customer happy with fix, wants a brief postmortem summary and the credit amount. I'll coordinate. :white_check_mark:
